name: The Restraint Forge
body: Arianna builds things that hold people, and that sentence means something different here than anywhere else. At St. Jonah's restraint meant someone else's rules around your throat. Here it means a cuff that closes with the tenderness of a held hand and a release mechanism built into every clasp, because the point was never to trap — the point was to prove that staying is sweeter when leaving is always an option. Heavy workbench and vise, modular toolboard, forge elements, a leather-working station, racks of finished work. The air tastes like myrrh and hot iron. Lili's steel-ring collar was made here.
